name: Peter Pan's Flight
sensoryNotes: Gently glides through dark scenes with glowing UV sets. Very smooth, but completely dark in parts.
adhdTip: Line moves slowly and can feel claustrophobic indoors. Use Premier Access or visit during parade times.

name: Pirates of the Caribbean
sensoryNotes: Two small surprise drops in the dark. Loud cannon fire, sword fights, fire effects, and skeleton figures.
adhdTip: The queue line is long, dark, and winding. High visual interest keeps kids engaged, but loud ambient screams can startle.

name: Big Thunder Mountain
sensoryNotes: Very fast, loud rattling mine train. Pitch black underwater tunnel drop at the end with loud train whistle.
adhdTip: Ear defenders strongly recommended. The sensation of speed is fantastic for sensory seekers.

name: The Lion King: Rhythms of the Pride Lands
sensoryNotes: World-class West End quality stage production. Live drums, aerial acrobatics, vibrant lighting, and booming sound.
adhdTip: Enclosed air-conditioned theater. Great mid-afternoon sensory reset, though loud percussion throughout.
